name: minimum_spanning_tree
author: 5c98c8eb
description: Computes a minimum spanning tree for a connected undirected graph, or a minimum spanning forest for a disconnected undirected graph, using Kruskal's algorithm. Returns selected edges, their total weight, component count, and a registered result subgraph. The top_k parameter limits the number of edges displayed in the result.

graph_id.description: ID of the graph to analyse.

top_k.description: Maximum number of selected edges to display.
